verdict.rationale: The full-application end of the story is documented: SvelteKit builds full apps, SPAs and static sites (likened to Next/Nuxt), and Svelte compiles self-contained components. Nothing in the pack shows the incremental-adoption path, such as mounting a Svelte component into part of an existing page or growing from embedded widgets into an app. `sv add` only extends existing Svelte projects, and the React-migration anecdote does not describe incremental adoption. missing for 10: documented embedding/mounting of components into a small part of an existing page, guidance on incrementally scaling from widget to full app, independent corroboration of incremental adoption.
